title: Diagramming & Docs: C4 Model — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the Diagram-as-Code CI/CD Pipeline: from markdown/Mermaid commit in Git through automated rendering to the Developer Portal.
routing_rationale: Treating diagrams as code versioned alongside Terraform configurations prevents architectural documentation from drifting out of sync with production.

nodes.label: architecture.c4 Git Commit
nodes.detail: Developer pushes updated C4 container topology alongside feature branch.

nodes.label: C4 Model Syntax Linter
nodes.detail: Validates boundary tags, relationships, and ensures no orphan nodes exist.

nodes.label: Mermaid SVG Generator
nodes.detail: Compiles text DSL into responsive vector SVG diagrams and embeds into HTML docs.

nodes.label: Docs GCS Bucket
nodes.detail: Stores static documentation artifacts behind Cloud CDN.

nodes.label: Backstage Catalog Portal
nodes.detail: Displays interactive C4 diagrams with zoomable components for 500+ engineers.

steps.title: Validation & Compilation
steps.action: Cloud Build runs linter on C4 DSL and renders vector SVGs.
steps.why_traversal: Treats documentation with the same testing rigor as application code.

steps.title: Publication & Discovery
steps.action: Artifacts published to GCS bucket; Backstage Developer Portal displays latest architecture.
steps.why_traversal: Provides single source of architectural truth accessible to the entire organization.

scenarios.label: Invalid Diagram Syntax Blocks PR Merge
scenarios.root_cause: Pull request contained broken Mermaid syntax with unclosed relationship arrow.
scenarios.diverted_path: CI check fails; PR blocked from merging into main branch.
scenarios.blast_radius: Prevents broken documentation from contaminating production portal.
scenarios.recovery: Fix syntax error locally, test with mermaid-cli, and push revised commit.
